notes_for_editor: Thin record. No source read gives a build date, builder, design beyond map tags, staffing, notable fires, fate, access or current condition, so the story leaves those out. Brief status and access stay unknown. The osm.json pipeline flags this OSM node as standing; that is a map flag, not a check, and is not used. Coordinates: the brief's OSM point (29.9975, -82.8622) and the USGS monitoring point (29.99773, -82.86179) are about 50 m apart, so they agree. The USGS record's name and atmosphere site type are the only sign of any later use of the site; what that monitoring measured is not stated in the record. Wikipedia's tower entry cites GNIS; the GNIS record itself was not fetched. Not used: Grokipedia (unverified aggregator) and anyplaceamerica (HTTP 403). No photos found.
